sections.text: Introduction

This document outlines the 
equipment inspection I3, which must be performed on an annually bases as 
indicated by Y1 as indicated in the title block.

The technical specification of gear box, power 
rating 1800 kw input speed 90.58 RPM, output speed 1000 RPM, gear ratio 0.9058, 
oil quantity 550 L

The 
first draft is initiated, tested and approved by eng. Abd El Mohsen Mohammed 
general manager of

Nag 
Hamady hyd. PS
Safety Precautions

A work permit must be issued and qualified maintanance staff should carry the 
 suitable safty category
Stop the crane and switch off the power supply.
Put suitable warning boards
